reason.description: Why the dispute is declined, in one or two sentences the cardholder can read.

policy_section_ids.description: Ids of the policy sections that support the decline, as returned by policy-mcp. At least one.

approval_token.description: Signed, single-use token from the human approval gate, bound to this dispute, this tool and these exact arguments. Use only a token you were given; never construct or reuse one.
